data.title: Replace JS iframe router with CSS-breakpoint single-page build (compiled index.html)

data.body: Decision context from user conversation: (1) Site switching must happen via CSS media queries, NOT JS — all sub-sites present in one index.html, inactive ones display:none. (2) User floated 'a light framework'; orchestrator chose a zero-dependency hand-rolled Node build script instead (node build.js, no node_modules) because sub-sites are tiny hand-authored static folders that should remain standalone-previewable; frameworks like Astro would force restructuring into components. Reversible if user objects. (3) Built index.html is committed (GitHub Pages serves as-is, no CI). (4) Site folders (random/, liquid/, memphis/) remain the source of truth; build transforms/scopes each site's CSS and JS into the combined page. (5) Bucket map: 100px-wide desktop buckets, random at 800-900, random as default elsewhere for now; mobile portrait/landscape slots reserved.

Built the compiled single-page architecture per plan: build.js (zero-dep Node, deterministic — double build byte-identical, sha 5d91a915), sites.config.json, template.html (head boilerplate verbatim from old root index.html); rewrote random/script.js to the SITES-registry contract (root.querySelectorAll everywhere, dead 'window.onclick = init()' line removed) and random/index.html to end-of-body boot; root index.html rebuilt with no iframe/matchMedia/BUCKET_SITES; CLAUDE.md Site Architecture section replaced with the section-7 text. Verified via node --check, static greps (og/twitter/canonical counts match template, no bare html/body selectors in scoped block, @import hoisted first), and a 20-check headless-Chromium CDP suite against http.server: exactly-one-site-visible at 500/800/850/899/900/1200px and mobile portrait/landscape emulation, letter hover + band mouseleave recolor, 4th-band click opens mailto:_@forrestalmasi.com, standalone /random/ text/behavior identical to combined, consoles clean; also exercised the general visibility algorithm with a synthetic 2-site config (bucket + mobile hide-lists correct) and validation failures (bad bucket key, missing site folder) exit 1. Deviations: none material — CLAUDE.md was already tracked by FA-1's commit 29427ed (plan expected untracked; staged as a modification), and template.html drops two trailing spaces present in the old meta lines. Commit 9039ece on liquid.

REVIEW (commit 9039ece, cold read vs plan): PASS with one trivial inline fix (committed as 95f90f9).

Verified:
- build.js: zero-dep stdlib only, deterministic (ran twice, git clean). node --check passes on build.js and random/script.js. Validation covers all plan cases (config schema, bucket-key multiples, missing site files, body-regex fail, literal </style>/</script>, unsupported at-rules, template markers).
- CSS transform: html/body/:root -> #site-random rewrite correct, descendant prefixing correct, @media preludes untouched with inner rules recursed (the 3 max-width blocks survive intact), @import hoisted to top of the site style block, html/body dedupe works. No bare html{/body{ in the site block.
- Visibility CSS: tested the GENERAL algorithm with a synthetic 2-site config (default random, buckets 800/1200 -> blue, mobile portrait=random landscape=blue) — output correct: base hide-all+show-default, ascending disjoint range blocks swapping default->bucket, mobile blocks last overriding buckets. Exactly one site visible at every width incl. 900px boundary (ranges gapless); range-syntax degradation falls back to default; mobile queries use only widely-parsed features.
- Runtime (chrome-headless-shell, served via http.server): combined page at 850x600 renders 47 animated letters + 5 random section backgrounds, console clean; /random/ standalone identical (47 letters, 5 backgrounds, console clean). Boot contract SITES['random'](element|document) works in both modes. Hover/touch/mouseleave/mailto handlers verified by static read — helpers byte-identical to pre-FA-4 except document->root queries and removal of the no-op window.onclick line. JS-disabled behavior (empty colored-less sections) matches pre-existing behavior.
- Built index.html: GENERATED banner, all 10 og: metas + twitter + canonical + viewport verbatim from template.html; no <iframe>/matchMedia/BUCKET_SITES/site-frame anywhere in repo. CNAME/favicon/splash untouched.
- CLAUDE.md Site Architecture matches plan section 7 exactly; authoring contract is sufficient to add memphis/liquid unaided.
- Commit hygiene: 9039ece staged exactly the 7 planned paths; .lattice/, agents.md, liquid/BRANDING.md, memphis/* untouched.

Inline fix (95f90f9): build.js marker substitution used String.replace with string replacements, where $&/$'/$` are special patterns — a future site whose inlined JS/CSS contains them would be silently corrupted. Switched to function replacements; current output byte-identical.

Notes (no action needed): random/style.css sets position:fixed on html vs position:relative on body — both map to the wrapper, relative wins; rendering verified fine and the CLAUDE.md contract already warns against conflicting html/body properties. CSS splitter is not string-aware (a brace inside content:'…' would misparse) — acceptable under the documented authoring conventions.
